verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the documented run lifecycle, which includes a "Delayed" state. That implies Trigger.dev natively supports delaying runs, but the evidence never describes how to set a delay, and nothing shows debouncing or batching of triggers to collapse noisy event streams. Concurrency limits and idempotency are adjacent controls and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documented debounce option, documented batch-trigger capability, explicit docs on configuring delayed triggers, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a backend developer, I debounce, batch, or delay triggers so noisy event streams collapse into the runs I actually want

citations.quote: A run can go through **various** states during its lifecycle...Pending version...Delayed...Queued...Dequeued...Executing
